Industry tracks pause during pointer hover or focus; explicit pause additionally exposes horizontally scrollable static rows. Both tracks resumed after focus and pointer left the ticker.

limits: The current browser check is desktop-only. Earlier mobile and Workstation reports remain historical and are not represented as new runs.

Contact links were inspected without placing a call or sending an email or WhatsApp message.
Console metrics and radar values remain clearly labelled illustrative examples; no backend or external channel integration was added.
